criteria.support_condition: A documented population of relevant deals announced by March 24, 2026 shows that more than half have definitively and irreversibly failed to produce the proposed facilities.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least half of that same population is completed under a consistent definition of completion, making a majority of permanent failures impossible.
